title: Meet Mere Man Ke
desc: Thakur Jagat Pratap Singh, a man of high principles falls in love with a girl and wants to marry her. However, the difference in their social statuses threatens to maim his plans.

title: Aa Gale Lag Jaa
desc: Roshni, a rich girl, is adamant on marrying Suraj, who is poor, until her mother reveals that his father is a former convict. Later, people around them are brutally killed by a seemingly unstoppable assailant.

title: Waqt
desc: An earthquake tears a businessman's family apart. Years later, they reunite in a courtroom trial where the father meets his sons under unprecedented circumstances.

title: Phande Baaz
desc: A clever man uses wit and disguise to outsmart villains and protect his loved ones.
